intro: Following the trail begun with a waterlogged parchment found in the Swamp of Sorrows, a second cryptic verse urges travelers to a far-off land in Kalimdor. Deciphering the lines points treasure hunters toward a cave in the southwest of Dustwallow Marsh.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A far off land in Kalimdor awaits
Where peril has dashed hopes and fates
East of Barrens the weather is harsh
Gloom and danger pock Dustwallow Marsh
But there lies a clue for those up to the test
Waiting to be found in a cave in the southwest
